_notes.metric: F1 of the anomalous class (TRUE), the official Track 1 metric
_notes.threshold: the runner picks one threshold on pooled out-of-fold probabilities (0.01 grid) and applies the same threshold to test_proba.csv to write submission.csv. The threshold is chosen on the same OOF predictions it is scored on: selection bias of unknown size, same procedure for every candidate.
_notes.max_run_seconds: per run, for training on cached features. Label-free feature extraction runs outside the runner (see PROTOCOL.md).
_notes.exploration_deadline: competition ends 16:00; 15:00-15:45 is for final checks and the last upload
